text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Etobicoke York Community Council designate Berl Avenue between The Queensway and Daniels Street as a through highway.
The Etobicoke York Community Council recommends that: 1. Designated Berl Avenue between the north side of The Queensway and south side of Daniels Street as a through highway.
